content.short: TON Hedge is a next-generation trading platform built for derivatives activity on the TON blockchain.
content.description: TON Hedge presents itself as a next-generation trading platform on TON. The public site is minimal, so this entry keeps the explanation narrow: it belongs in the derivatives group as a TON trading venue rather than a general wallet or exchange aggregator. Users should review the live app, market depth, and risk controls before using it for leveraged activity. Next generation trading platform on TON blockchain. For TON Hedge, the TON value is the specific DeFi action it enables, from market access and routing to yield, liquidity, or position management.
